title: The World Of Bob
description: A silly mod themed around a new mod named bob, that adds bob versions of Minecraft mobs and even a bob dimension!
body:
A silly mod themed around a new mod named bob, that adds bob versions of Minecraft mobs and even a bob dimension!

Current blocks and items are 
- Cut bob stone
- Chiseled bob stone 
- bob planks 
- bob stairs 
- bob slab
- bob fence 
- bob fence gate
